instruction: A small playground: a slide tower with a platform, roof, ladder and a curved slide; a swing set frame with two swings; a mulch/sand ground base; and a low perimeter curb enclosing the area. Meter-scale layout, bright primary colors.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a small playground. A small playground: a slide tower with a platform, roof, ladder and a curved slide; a swing set frame with two swings; a mulch/sand ground base; and a low perimeter curb enclosing the area. Meter-scale layout, bright primary colors. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
